cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk about trying again, but I'll sit beside the door. Please move that chair; an exit needs to stay clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're confusing an available exit with a plan to use it. Knowing I can leave is what lets me sit down. Shall we begin?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop whenever you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I want to come home. Please treat that as a statement, not a moving arrangement. Ask me how it feels before you offer a key.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 corrects exit clearance, A3 teaches the difference between option and intention, and A5 distinguishes a vulnerable statement from an arrangement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 fears A will run; B4's stop-anytime agreement supplies the safety for A5's wish to return.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers a useful condition instead of contesting A's vulnerability.

heightening.evidence: A5 answers B4's safety offer with real hope, then limits immediate practical consequences.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes trying-again talk by a door and A5 the wish to come home.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's question-before-key instruction tells B how to respond now without a thematic tail.
